content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend wool skirt, knee-length A-line cut in a structured fit, charcoal grey (#36454F), fine woven wool; Wool-cotton blend blouse, classic pointed collar with soft pleats and long sleeves, navy blue (#000080), smooth poplin cotton; Tweed blazer, single-breasted with notch lapels and two front pockets, dark forest green (#1B3A2E), coarse herringbone tweed; Leather Chelsea ankle boots, rounded toe with a low block heel for traction on snow, black (#000000), full-grain nubuck leather. This outfit balances professional polish with essential warmth for a -10 °C walk in snowy conditions. The wool skirt and heavy tweed blazer provide the necessary insulation against the biting cold while maintaining a neat silhouette appropriate for a business meeting. Dark, rich tones like charcoal and forest green convey authority and stability without appearing overly severe for a standard work occasion."}
